posts.en:
dsh-plugin-hooks is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Claude-Code-style lifecycle hooks: configured shell commands run before/after model tool calls with a JSON payload on stdin; a non-zero pre-tool exit blocks the call.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-1be090439c6b5908484d.html
